'''Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder''' was an inter-galactic nomadic [[Circus/Legends|circus]] troupe owned and directed by [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo]]. The attraction occasionally passed by [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], where the circus would put on a show for [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the circus operated from a [[Preigo's YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighter]] flown by three [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. The act employed Aleena and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] as [[Juggling|jugglers]] and [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobats]], in addition to [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Convor/Legends|convor]]-handlers and a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Clown/Legends|clown]]. The circus' menagerie of creatures also included a [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]], a [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]], and a pair of [[Dalgo/Legends|dalgos]].<ref name="Bound" />

==History==
During a performance for the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]], one of [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo's]] acts displeased Ohnaka, who had the offending performers beheaded.<ref name="Bound" />

In a later presentation to the pirate on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Circus/Legends|circus]] had been infiltrated by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]], and [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], who had come to [[Rescue on Florrum/Legends|rescue]] their Jedi chaperone [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from Hondo's custody. While Ohnaka and his pirates initially their [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobatic]] performance as the "[[Animal Instincts/Legends|Animal Instincts]]," the deception was revealed when Katooni freed Ahsoka. The pirates attacked the circus and the younglings, forcing Preigo to retreat inside the circus craft and flee, leaving some of his acts behind in the process.<ref name="Bound" />
